b: In tons of adventure movies / shows there's the trope "one or two unlikely nobodies do something that genuinely single handedly saves the whole world".

A lot of times the protagonist goes without credit, as the "unknown" hero. Are there any examples of this happening in the real world that we either knew about when it happened or discovered later on?
I know there's tons of micro examples of this, saving a life, protesting for good, charities, etc. but has there ever been a worldwide catastrophe that was avoided due to any individual(s)?
